verdict.rationale: Funnel analytics are a fair axis for an identity-verification service, but the evidence pack never documents a funnel dashboard, pass-rate reporting, or drop-off and completion-time breakdowns by country or document type. The Customer Portal Verifications page is only documented for manually reviewing sessions. The optional event webhook reports session progress, but it is a developer building block for constructing analytics, not the analytics capability itself.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see verification funnel analytics — pass rates, drop-off points, completion time by country and document type — to know what verification is costing me in signups
